acceptance_reason: All recovered validation queries separate the top true and best false observation only through missing-field effects. C1's asymmetric partial-observation construction is an accidental predictive pattern, not defensible identity evidence. Reject both learned rankers; preserve their measured results without retuning the benchmark.
rule: Require >=2 net validation top1 wins, better MRR, no increase in raw or gated wrong top1. Prefer LR unless XGB adds >=2 wins with better MRR and no worse FP at 0.9/0.99.
